name: Tsukiotoshi Yuurei
source:
Come evening time, the school is empty. Do not turn around while walking down the stairs of the school building. If you turn around, you will be pushed down by a ghost.

[Translated from [url=http://t-o-k.sakura.ne.jp/yuugi/s/tukiotoshi.htm]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
傍晚时分，学校空无一人。走下教学楼楼梯时，不要回头。
如果回头，就会被鬼推下去。

[译自[url=http://t-o-k.sakura.ne.jp/yuugi/s/tukiotoshi.htm]官方网站[/url]]
